description: This PHP class defines an entity for logging user login activities in the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_login' database table and includes properties such as user ID, username, user role, role type, and login timestamp, along with corresponding getter/setter methods. The class utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and a trait for handling DateTime operations.

classes.name: LoginLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a login attempt or session log, including user details and login time.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user associated with this login log.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for this login log.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username associated with this login log.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username for this login log.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Returns the role name of the user.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the role name for the user.

methods.name: getUserRolePredefined
methods.description: Returns the predefined role type as an integer.
